Chulabhorn Graduate Institute (CGI) Post-Graduate Scholarship Program 2023-24 is an opportunity offered by the Chulabhorn Graduate Institute (CGI), Bangkok. The programme invites applications from graduate students under 30 years of age. The purpose of this scholarship is to support the study of students willing to pursue a Master’s degree at Chulabhorn Graduate Institute. Selected students will receive tuition and other academic fees, accommodation, round trip airfare, monthly stipend, book allowance, health insurance and other benefits.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
hold a bachelor's degree with a cumulative GPA of at least 2.75 (on 4 point scale) in one of the following fields -
Chemistry, Biology, Biological Sciences, Molecular Biology, Environmental Sciences
Applicants from other related fields are also welcome to apply)
have experience in scientific laboratory research
have demonstrated English proficiency, preferably TOEFL or IELTS
provide a statement of purpose explaining the interest in the study
be applying to postgraduate studies in one of the following fields:
have an annual family income of less than INR 4,50,000

Note - Applicants who have achieved a CGPA of 6.88 or higher on a 10-point scale are eligible to apply. Alternatively, candidates who have obtained a percentage of 68.8% or above in their last qualifying examination are also eligible to apply.

Candidates will be selected based on meeting eligibility criteria and academic excellence.
Annual review of the scholar’s academic progress will decide the continuation of the scholarship for the next academic year.
The scholarship will cover 6 weeks of refresher courses followed by a period of 2 years of master's degree study.
The tentative date for the commencement of refresher courses is June 2024.
The academic program will commence in August 2024.
